About Us

A brighter Africa is possible.
And we’re making it.

RE.Think Energy is a pan-African advisory and solutions platform that connects people, ideas and capital to turn Africa’s renewable energy potential into real, lasting impact.

Our Story →
Our Mission

To turn Africa’s energy potential into real-world impact.

We bring together the people, ideas, capital and capabilities needed to accelerate a just and inclusive energy transition — creating lasting value for people, economies and the planet.

Learn more about our mission
A Just Transition

More clean energy, more opportunities, more local value.

Inclusive growth that leaves no one behind.

Resilient energy systems for a brighter tomorrow.

How we do it

We bring together the right people, ideas and solutions — combining technical expertise, strategic partnerships and deep African context to move from ambition to implementation.

More projects. More investment. Stronger systems. More local value.

Africa isn't waiting for permission to build its energy future — it's waiting for the infrastructure, capital, and policy to catch up.

by Wangari Muchiri, Founder & C.E.O, RE.Think Energy

Wangari Muchiri

Founder & C.E.O, RE.Think Energy
The Thinking Behind RE.Think

Wangari Muchiri is a renewable energy engineer with over 16 years of experience across the sector. She previously served as Africa Director at the Global Wind Energy Council (GWEC), holds engineering degrees from Australian universities, and completed her MBA at Oxford. She is currently the Africa Advisor to the Global Solar Council and the Global Wind Energy Council.

Where we work

Headquartered in Nairobi. Built for the whole continent.

From our base in Nairobi, we've engaged governments, regulators, and institutions in more than 15 African countries — structuring the policy and investment pathways their renewable energy transitions need.
